Schedule of Final Exam of Fall 2026 for Undergraduate Programs

(Except Pharmacy and LLB)


Class Days Last Day of Classes Final Exam Day Final Exam Date
ST 08 December 2026 Sunday 13 December 2026
TR 10 December 2026 Tuesday 15 December 2026
MW 09 December 2026 Monday 14 December 2026
SR 10 December 2026 Thursday 17 December 2026

Sunday, 20 December 2026 is earmarked for Final Exams for students who will have more than two exams in a single day as per the schedule above. The class teachers will collect the information from the students immediately who have more than two exams on a single day and report it to respective chairpersons for rescheduling these exams on Sunday, 20 December 2026.

Faculty Members are requested to announce the above dates of the Examinations in the class.
